title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#7
text:
Sign Documents from In Basket
Save time and paper by applying a "wet" or handwritten signature to documents electronically in the new
Document Signature In Basket folder. From the Document Signatures folder in In Basket, you can review the
document and see where your signature will be placed (1). After reviewing the document, you can choose to
sign the document or decline it (2). Depending on your system configuration, options for signing on screen or
using a signature pad might appear (3). After signing, you can save a signature for future use (4).
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#8
text:
View Canceled and Rescheduled Appointments
See canceled and rescheduled appointments on your schedule to understand schedule changes. Canceled and
rescheduled appointments appear highlighted in gray with the time crossed out. This helps you quickly identify
gaps and follow up with patients if needed. If you prefer to not see these appointments, filter them using the
Filter by Status options.
Key Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#9
text:
More Colors for Schedule Color Flags
Purple, pink, and orange are now available as color flags to give you at-a-glance information about
appointment- or patient-related information.
Key Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#10
text:
Quickly Review How a Patient Is Taking a Medication
To more quickly review whether a patient is taking their
medication as prescribed, the Medication Management section
now shows descriptive icons in place of the Taking checkbox. Click
the icon to update the Taking status.
• means taking as prescribed.
• means taking differently.
• icon means not taking at all.
• means the patient doesn't know.
• means no status has been documented.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#11
text:
Send Your Common Communications Faster
To save time drafting letters and reports, use a template based on what you've written to patients or other
clinicians in the past. Click Create to generate a letter, then review and edit as needed before sending.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#12
text:
Opt Out of In Basket Messages
Take advantage of message preference to
automatically filter messages that you aren't
reading.
From your In Basket home screen, you
might see suggestion cards that remind you
of options that allow you to opt out of the
following In Basket Folders:
• Addendum Notifications
• Appointment Notifications
• Hospital ADT
• Covered Work
• Expiring Orders
• Height/Weight Change
• Outside Events
Key Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#13
text:
Use Multiple Express Lanes at Once
To help you accelerate your documentation when
a patient mentions multiple problems during a
visit, you can now open multiple Express Lanes at
once. Even if you're in the middle of editing the
first Express Lane, if a patient mentions a second
problem, you can search for and add a second
Express Lane using the + Add SmartSet button.
Both Express Lanes appear together, allowing you
to provide more complete care, documenting in
either Express Lane, before signing them together.
(Feature is only available if your department has Express Lanes
activity associated with specific Visit Types)
Key Changes
Time Saver

text: Key Changes: Physician Updates - Open

title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#15
text:
Copy Forward Procedure Documentation
When you need to perform a procedure and you've documented
that procedure for the patient in the past, save time by copying
forward your previous procedure documentation.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

text:
Complete Results Messages from Result Management
When you review a result in Result
Management, select the Mark
message as done checkbox to
mark the associated In Basket
Result message as done at the
same time.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#17
text:
Trend INR with the Goal Range
When you trend INR data in Synopsis, you can now see the patient's INR goal as a shaded range on the graph.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#18
text:
Let SmartLinks Do the Calculations for eGFR Scores
More easily find chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients' estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) by pulling in
the rate and calculation information into your notes using SmartLinks. The following new SmartLinks pull in a
calculated eGFR score based on current equations provided by the National Kidney Foundation (NKF) and the
American Society of Nephrology (ASN):
• For serum creatinine, use .EGFRCRE
• For cystatin C, use .EGFRCYS
• For a combination, use .EGFRCRECYS
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#19
text:
Waste Is Automatically Calculated
When you administer a medication in
the clinic and need to discard the
extra, the waste is automatically
calculated for you by subtracting the
quantity you administered from the
NDC's package size.
You can update the waste, if needed,
by deleting what's in the Waste field
and entering a different amount.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#20
text:
Chart from Patient Messages
When you're writing a message to a patient, you can
now quickly access the taskbar to place an order or
enter a diagnosis by clicking the Load Clinical Tools
button (1).
Use the taskbar to enter orders or add diagnoses (2).
Key Changes

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#21
text:
See Fewer Duplicate Chart Completion Messages
You now have more time to sign your notes before receiving Chart
Completion In Basket messages. Messages for incomplete note
and cosign note deficiencies are now sent on a delay, so you're
less likely to receive another In Basket message for the same task.
Key Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#22
text:
New Coding Queries for Professional Charges
Correspond with professional coders and update documentation with new outpatient coding query messages in
In Basket.
• Use the New Note button to create a new note to respond to the query or address the deficiency.
• Use the Already Done/Documented button to send an automatic reply that the query has been addressed.
• Use the Request Clarification button to ask the coder for more information.
Key Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#23
text:
Collaborate on Care for Patients with Rare or
Unknown Conditions
When you're seeing a patient with a rare condition, unknown condition, or set of unusual symptoms, use Look-
Alikes to find providers across the Epic community who’ve seen similar patients so you can reach out and
collaborate. Search the chart for Look-Alikes to open the activity.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#24
text:
Explore In Basket Messages Reporting with
SlicerDicer
Use the new Sender filters in the Messages data model in SlicerDicer to investigate messages sent by all users,
providers, and people outside your organization as well as messages with statuses changed by all users and
providers within your organization.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#25
text:
Document Sex and Gender in a More Inclusive
Pedigree
To help provide care that is respectful of a person’s gender, you can now document both a patient’s and relative’s
sex assigned at birth and their gender identity in the Pedigree, and you can see what others have documented
with easy-to-read symbols. For example, a person who was assigned male at birth and identifies as male is
indicated by a square, while a person who was assigned male at birth and identifies as female is indicated by a
circle with the letters AMAB below it. We've also renamed the Genetic Sex field to Sex Assigned at Birth and
added the option to choose Unassigned.
Key Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#26
text:
Quicker Visits with Pended Express Lanes
To speed up routine visits, you or your clinic support staff can start an Express Lane and then pend it, queueing
up documentation and orders for you to review and finalize later.
Clinic staff can click Pend (A) to pend an Express Lane. An icon (B) appears in the taskbar if an Express Lane has
been pended.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#27
text:
Answer Questions About Appointment Requests
Scheduling questions about an order now appear in the Appointment Requests folder in In Basket.
Key Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#28
text:
Diagnosis-Aware Notes for Outpatient
You can now write an assessment and plan for a diagnosis in a progress note or other note type and
automatically save the text as an A&P note to the problem, making it easier to track trends in a patient's
conditions and the effectiveness of treatments for each condition over time.
Key Changes

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

text: Key Changes: Nurse Updates - Open

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

text:
Uncascade Accidental Flowsheet Rows
If you enter a value in
flowsheets by mistake that
causes more flowsheet rows
to cascade in, you can now
rewind and uncascade those
rows by removing or
correcting the value.
Key Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#31
text:
Vitals Screen Gets a Vital Refresh
You can do more documentation directly in the Vitals screen without needing to open Flowsheet Vitals. Mark
vitals as significant and add comments with new buttons and keyboard shortcuts.
Click the flag icon next to a field or press Alt+S to mark that value as significant.
Click the note icon next to a field or press Alt+M to add a comment for that value.
Key Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

text:
Queue Up Express Lanes for Quick Visits
To speed up routine
visits for Departments
that use Express Lanes,
you can start an Express
Lane when you room a
patient and then pend
it, queueing up
documentation and
orders for the doctor to
review and finalize later.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#33
text:
Document Patient Education on the Go
Keep track of a patient’s education progress and see a preview of
what your patients will see in linked web pages, all in Rover or
Haiku.
In the Education activity, you can filter their education list (A), tap
an education item's name to get more details (B), and document
new education items, including details like the method and
learner’s response (C).
To mark an item as not applicable, delete an item, or resolve an
item, tap the checkbox next to it, tap More, and select the action
you want to take for the item.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#34
text:
Make On-the-Fly Care Team Updates with Ease
You can now add care team members on the fly and make updates to a patient's episode care team right in your
navigator, instead of going to the Care Teams activity. From the Episode Care Team navigator, you can also open
a secure chat message with a member of the episode care team and add an episode-specific address for a team
member.
Key Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#35
text: Additional Changes: Cross-Role Updates - Open

title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#36
text:
Find External Notes by Signer or Cosigner
You can now filter external notes by Author or Note Action (1) or by Contributor (2). The external note
icon appears in the Care Everywhere column (3) to indicate the note is from an external organization.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#37
text:
See More Detail About Appointment Statuses
After you sign a scheduling order in a treatment plan or therapy
plan, see more scheduling information, like detailed status and
notes schedulers or patients made about the appointment. From
Treatment Plan Manager, click the link to open scheduling
information for the order in a report. From a therapy plan, hover
over the order and click a link for each requested date to see more
information.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#38
text:
See When Care Everywhere Documents Exclude
Sensitive Information
When a Care Everywhere document excludes sensitive information, a new banner appears at the top of the
document, so you don't need to scroll through each section to see whether the patient received care that isn't
disclosed in the document.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#39
text:
Screen Patients with the Zero Suicide Risk Assessment
Assess a patient's risk of
dying by suicide using the
Henry Ford Zero Suicide
Risk Assessment. Your
organization might have
made this assessment
available as a navigator
section in a location such
as the Screenings activity
or in the Flowsheets
activity.
Additional Changes

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#40
text:
Attach Clinical References with a Single Click
Quickly attach your most frequently used clinical references by creating speed buttons in the Patient Instructions
or Discharge Instructions navigator section. Open the My Notes Settings window, search for the clinical
reference you want to attach, and then click Add.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#41
text:
Trend Patient- and Clinician-Entered Data Together
You might start to see patient- and clinician-entered data appear in the same flowsheet row depending on your
organization’s flowsheet design, and you can trend the readings from both sources in a single line on a graph.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#42
text:
Compare Home Monitoring Data to Data from the
Current Encounter
When you’re reviewing information from a patient’s related encounters alongside their current encounter, like
the in the Flowsheets and Synopsis activities, you might also start to see relevant patient-entered data, giving
you a more detailed picture of the patient’s health trends.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#43
text:
See the Data Source at a Glance in Trending Tools
Quickly identify the source for each data point in Growth Charts, Health Trends, Review Flowsheets, and Synopsis
with new device-reported (A) and patient-reported (B) icons. Patient-reported data can be turned off above the
table (C) in Synopsis and Review Flowsheets.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#44
text:
Declutter In Basket by Filtering Certain Auto-Routed
Messages
To keep your In Basket neat and tidy,
you can suppress certain types of
automatically routed note or
transcription messages.
Open the Message Settings tab of
your In Basket preferences and select
one or more message type to opt out
of.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#45
text:
Easy-to-Spot Message Categories
Message categories used to help you quickly identify what you
need to do with In Basket messages are now easier to spot and
update.
The categories applied to a message now appear at the top, where
clinicians can also add or edit the categories care team members
have applied. You can also choose subcategories for the following
categories to make it even easier to respond quickly. For example,
you can tag a message in the Medication category as either a
question, a request, or a concern about interactions:
• Medication
• Results
• Lab
• Procedure/DME
• Referral
Additional Changes
New Look

text:
Send Confidential Messages to Patients or Proxies
Limit who can see In Basket messages by clearing the checkbox of the patient or proxies that shouldn't be
included.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#47
text:
See Dose Warnings When You Document Home
Medications
Document home medication
doses with more confidence
knowing that dose warnings
now appear if you type a
high or low dose by accident.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#48
text:
More Easily Find Date of Diagnosis
To make it more convenient for you to find the date a problem was diagnosed, a new column shows that date in
problem list reports designed for use in gynecology, fertility, prenatal, and L&D workflows.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#49
text:
Choose Any Condition in Family History
Choose from all the conditions available in your system when you're documenting family history in the Family
History navigator section or the Pedigree activity instead of from only a history-specific preference list. The extra
specificity allows you to discretely document family histories that more closely match the histories reported by
patients.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#50
text:
Write Telephone and Nursing Notes Faster
You can now use
NoteWriter to write
your telephone
encounter notes and
nursing notes.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#51
text:
View Problem Related Meds and Labs in the This Visit
Tab
Hover over the PRML icon in the Problem List section of the This Visit tab to view relevant medications and lab
results without having to open the Problem List activity.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#52
text:
Change Provider Name Format in the Schedule
To help organize the schedule tree and find specific providers
more quickly, right-click anywhere in the tree to switch between
"First Last" and "Last, First."
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#53
text:
Social Drivers of Health, Not Determinants
In Chart Review, Storyboard, and elsewhere in the system, you see the term social drivers of health instead
of social determinants of health to help emphasize patient agency over their health outcomes.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#54
text:
OurPractice Advisories Belong to You
BestPractice Advisories are now named OurPractice Advisories to more clearly indicate that the clinical decision-
making content in them is defined by your organization.
If you search for advisories in a list, like in SlicerDicer or In Basket folders, they now appear under "O" instead of
"B."
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#55
text:
See More Easily Which Genomic Indicators Have Been
Shared to MyChart
New icons in the Genomic Indicators activity show you which indicators have been shared with patients in
MyChart:
• A dash appears if the indicator can't be shared because of build or isn't set to be shared.
• A gray computer appears if the patient or their proxy doesn't have a MyChart account.
• A blue person appears if the linked order hasn't been released to MyChart yet.
• A pink heart appears if the indicator has been shared to MyChart.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#56
text:
Manage Patients with a History of Skin Cancer
Identify patients with a history of melanoma and other skin cancers who have not been seen in the last 12
months using the Melanoma and Skin Cancer Registry Patients Reporting Workbench report. Use the toolbar
options to follow-up with these patients to help ensure they get the care they need to prevent future cancers.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#57
text:
Order Again in Chart Review
When selecting an existing lab, procedure, or imaging order, click Order Again from the toolbar or right-click
menu to create and place a new order with the same details or with details from your preference list.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#58
text:
Create a Flowsheet History Report On the Fly
You can now create
customized reports of
flowsheet data that you can
save as a PDF or print from
the Flowsheet History
button. For example, you
might need to gather
requested patient
information to present to
surveyors at your long-term
care facility.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#59
text:
Welcome to the New Health Maintenance
See why patients qualify for Health Maintenance topics more easily, and view care gaps in groups that help you
structure your conversations with patients. When you're ready to act, click to place orders right from the activity,
either for all care gaps, or just the gaps you're ready to address now.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#60
text:
Shine a Light on Patient Information with Spotlight
Cards in the Assistant Bar
When you search for patient information in the Assistant Bar, the
Assistant now shows Spotlight Cards that match your search as
you type, rather than only after you press Enter. This helps you
find the information you need more quickly without requiring you
to go to another activity.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#61
text:
Cleaner Chart Review Toolbars
To simplify Chart Review, we've moved several buttons that most clinicians use less than once per month to the
Rarely Used menu at the end of the toolbar.
To customize your toolbar, right-click a button and select Move to Rarely Used or Move back to main toolbar.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#62
text:
Manage Pending Orders Efficiently with In Basket
The Pending Orders folder in In Basket now let you view and act on both medication and non-medication orders
without leaving In Basket.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#63
text:
Manage Medications and Other Orders in Rx Request
Messages
On telephone encounters where medication orders are placed along with additional non-medication orders, you
can now view and act on all pending orders for that encounter in the same Rx Request message. Additionally,
you can now use Approve Rx Only or Edit Rx Only buttons to quickly sign or edit just the medication orders
on a message, even when there are also pending lab or imaging orders on that same message.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#64
text:
Calculate Hereditary Disease Risk Scores from the
Pedigree
When you click Risk Scores, the Risk Scores activity appears in the
sidebar, where you can review documentation for risk factors,
update those factors at the source as needed, and then calculate
multiple risk scores at the same time.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#65
text:
Add a Relationship Between Unlinked Relatives in the
Pedigree
Attach relatives to relationships in the Pedigree by dragging and dropping them to the right spot in the family
tree.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#66
text:
Choose How Best to Route a Note to Recipients
Recipients you're sending notes to have their preferred way for getting those notes, but that might not always
be the fastest or best way to reach them, such as when they're working at a different location than usual. If you
need to pick a different method or address to use for a recipient, click their name in the Routing window.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#67
text:
Defer a BestPractice Advisory in Hyperspace
You might not be able to immediately act on an advisory when it appears in Hyperspace. There's now an option
to defer advisories to the Storyboard so you can address them later. From Storyboard, you can open the
deferred advisory and take an action or select that the advisory is no longer applicable.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#68
text:
Mark Patient Contacts as Emergency Contacts
You can now set a patient contact as being an emergency contact for a patient. The Patient Contacts activity has
new sections to differentiate Emergency Contacts from Other Contacts and Inactive Contacts; use the checkbox
filters in the top right to customize your view of patient contacts.
You can move contacts between the Emergency Contacts and Other Contacts sections by dragging and
dropping, using the up and down arrow buttons, or clicking the pencil icon and changing the Emergency
Contacts item.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#69
text:
Customize Your View of the Anticoagulation
Storyboard
You can now configure the Anticoagulation Storyboard to show or hide certain episode details. Click the wrench
next to Anticoagulation Episode on the Storyboard and select which content you want to show or hide.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#70
text:
See Care Coordination Information in Storyboard
Hover over the Active Care Coordination Episode notification icon in Storyboard to see information related to a
patient's active programs, such as effective dates, responsible staff and departments, and social determinants of
health addressed.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#71
text:
Customize How You See Information in the
Medications Activity
Find relevant orders in the Medications activity more easily by collapsing groups of orders or changing the font
size.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#72
text:
Reconcile Outside Problems Without Their Notes
When you reconcile an outside problem, you can now choose to leave out its overview note. Clear the checkbox
to reconcile only the problem and not the note.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#73
text:
Parental Inheritance Replaces Variant Source
To avoid ambiguity and increase the precision of variant
documentation, we've made updates to how variant source and
parental inheritance are documented and appear in the system:
• De novo is no longer an allowed value in the Variant Source
field.
• The field formerly known as Allelic Phase is now Parental
Inheritance.
• The field formerly known as Basis for Allelic Phase is now Basis
for Parental Inheritance.
• You can enter De novo, Biparental, Not Maternal, and Not
Paternal in the Paternal Inheritance field.
• You can no longer enter Parental Inheritance for variants
whose source is Somatic or Likely Somatic.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#74
text:
Choose the Address to Route Results To
When you select an authorizing provider for an order, you can also select which address to use for that
provider. For most orders, it’s better to leave the address field blank and keep the default, but you might use this
option when a patient has a printed order from an external provider who works at multiple clinics and you want
to send the results to the address on the printed order.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#75
text:
Relevant Growth Charts for Babies
The appropriate growth chart data for infants—a full-term chart for full-term patients or a pre-term chart for
patients born prematurely—more consistently appears in the Growth Charts activity and is used for calculating
growth percentiles that appear in places like SmartLinks and reports.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#76
text:
Review Tobacco Use Warning Appears for
Adolescents
A reminder now appears for all patients 12 years and older if you mark the Tobacco Use section as reviewed
without first documenting whether the patient uses both smoking and smokeless tobacco. Previously, this
warning reminder appeared only for patients 18 years and older. It now appears for younger patients to align
with updated definitions for tobacco screening and cessation quality measures.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#77
text:
Smaller Banners Reduce Scrolling
To limit visual clutter and reduce scrolling, FYI and notification banners that previously stretched across the
section are now smaller. If you need more information, hover over the banner and click to see more details.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#78
text:
See a Timeline of Recent Ophthalmology Visits and
Surgeries
A patient's recent ophthalmology visits and surgeries now appear
together in your SnapShot report and ophthalmology sidebar,
making it easier to see a timeline of the patient's treatment.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#79
text:
Know When a Communication Wasn’t Sent
Check the status of a fax or printed
document from the
Communications navigator section
or routing reports.
The following status icons appear:
• A green checkmark when the
message was sent.
• A red X when the message wasn’t
sent.
• An hourglass icon if the message is
still being sent.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#80
text:
Find Your Patient's Immunizations in the List of
Potential Registry Matches
When an immunization
registry returns potential
patient matches from a query,
click the Select Matches
or Select a Match link in the
Immunizations activity to view
additional information about
those matches.
If there is an appropriate
match to the current patient,
select it to re-query the
immunization registry.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#81
text:
Slice and Dice Data with Care Companion Enrollment
Filters
Use new SlicerDicer filters in the Patient, Surgeries and Invasive Procedures, Births, and Coded Admissions data
models to help you understand how different parts of your organization are using Care Companion care plans
and what outcomes patients are seeing.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#82
text:
See More Detailed Information Regarding Care Plans
and Task Progress
The Patient Portal Care Plan report
now gives you a more in-depth
look at each patient's progress on
care plans they're assigned
through MyChart Care
Companion.
See an overview of overall patient
progress, plus specific details such
as task completion and upcoming
deadlines. Click the link in the
Most Recent Completion column
to dig into task details. The Task
Summary then shows all
occurrences of a task, including
when each one was due and
resolved.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#83
text:
Additional Changes: Clinic Manager Updates -
Open

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#84
text:
Track the Activities Schedulers Use to Make
Appointments
The new Appointments Scheduled by Mode component on the Clinic Manager - Scheduling dashboard helps
you ensure that the right tools are being used to schedule appointments. For example, higher usage of Book It
Solutions view during scheduling suggests that schedulers are being guided to the best scheduling solutions
rather than searching manually in Schedules view. Follow up with scheduling staff if you notice an upward trend
in usage for scheduling modes that you're not expecting.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#85
text:
See Inactive Members of In Basket Pools
When you’re managing members of a pool, people who are no
longer at your organization are now visible with a warning icon
instead of hidden from the list, allowing you to select and remove
them.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#86
text: Additional Changes: Physician Updates - Open

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#87
text:
Growth Charts for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
Length-for-age, weight-for-age, and BMI-for-age growth charts for boys (2-20 years) with Duchenne Muscular
Dystrophy (DMD) are available in the Growth Chart activity.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Refuel Phase 3/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - May 2024.pdf#88
text:
Cosign Note Deficiencies with Fewer Clicks
Save time when clearing your Chart Completion folder with new
Cosign and Attest links in both In Basket and the To Do sidebar.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

Calendars
To avoid potentially sending PHI from Epic to your external calendar in Microsoft Outlook or Google Calendar,

Authorization
You no longer need to wait for a payer to provide an exact price estimate to see whether a prescription requires
prior authorization from that payer. Now, if Real-Time Prescription Benefits (RTPB) can't retrieve a price estimate
from a payer, the Patient Estimates window still shows whether the payer requires prior authorization for the
medication.

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#2
text:
New Workflow
Potential Participant Screening via Our Practice Advisory
(OPA)
Research recruitment tools, such as OPAs (formerly known as Best Practice Advisory or BPA), are going to be available. An
example of this tool is the Point of Care OPA. OPAs can increase study recruitment efficiency by identifying potential study
candidates real-time under conditions that are tailored to the study.
When eligible patients come in for a visit, the advisory
appears based on information in the chart indicating the
patient is a potential candidate to participate in the study.
Note: The OPAs are available on study-to-study basis.

title: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment

meta.file: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#3
text:
New Workflow
Potential Participant Screening via Our Practice Advisory
(OPA): In Basket
When the provider indicates a patient is interested in participating in the study from the OPA, a Research Recruitment
message is sent to the research coordinator’s In Basket, and the patient is automatically associated with the study and
given a status of Interested.
Note: The OPAs are available on study-to-study basis.

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#5
text:
New Workflow
Research Recruitment Contact Preference
Research preference profiles in MyChart allow patients to indicate whether they want to be contacted about research
opportunities directly from MyChart. They can indicate OK to Contact, Do Not Contact, or Undecided. Patients have the
flexibility to update their responses at any time. This documentation can also be completed in Hyperspace.

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf
title: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment

meta.file: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#6
text:
New Workflow
Direct-to-Patient MyChart Recruitment
When a patient is identified as potentially eligible for a research study, a recruitment request can be sent either through the
Reporting Workbench report or straight from the patient's chart in the Research Studies activity. This request, including
details about the study, will be sent to the patient's MyChart.
The patient indicates whether he or she is interested in participating, and
an In Basket message is sent to the study team to follow up.
Note: This functionality is available on study-to-study basis.

text:
New Workflow
MyChart Research Preference Profile
Patients can click Create Profile on the Research Studies page in MyChart to fill out a questionnaire to indicate
their interest in the types of studies available.

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf
title: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment

meta.file: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#8
text:
Contraindicated Medication Warnings for Research
When a patient is enrolled in a research study, the ordering provider will receive a notification if the patient is at risk of
taking a medication that could potential result in an harmful reaction or jeopardize their participation in the study. If you
see this warning, check the storyboard to identify the study the patient is in.
Awareness
These warnings appear in the same locations and workflows as other medication warnings. If you feel the medication you
are ordering is necessary, please reach out to the principal investigator of the study for further discussion.
Note: This functionality is available on study-to-study basis.

title: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment

meta.file: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#9
text:
Show Research Participation in MyChart
Patients participating in a research study will be able to view the study title and description for each study they are
associated with in MyChart. This makes study information and recruitment opportunities accessible to patients, which can
help increase their engagement and participation.
Awareness
Patient can learn more about the new Research Studies section of
MyChart in the Explore More section on their main screen.

title: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment

meta.file: Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#10
text:
Research Consent
Users can add consent forms to confirm that a patient has consented to participate in a particular research study. Users can
electronically collect consents for research studies and link that consent to a specific study. Non-research users can see
these consent documents throughout the patient's chart.
New Workflow
E-signature
E-signature consent will be built on a study-by-study basis.
Scan/Import

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Phase 3 Point of Care –OPAs for potential participant screening recruitment.pdf#11
text:
New Workflow
When a study is amended, study coordinators can keep consents and treatment plans up-to-date for patients. For a given
amendment, they can indicate whether patients need to be re-consented and whether any updates are needed to their
treatment plans.
Amendments: Manage Consents and Treatment Plans
Doing so helps research coordinators identify patients who are affected by the changes and ensure that they sign
updated consent documents and receive modified treatment plans as appropriate.

text:
Neurology NoteWriter Exam Form
With the NoteWriter Neurology Exam Form, a provider will have the ability to document more accurate and up to date
information. NoteWriter translates your selections into sentences, which can help you to complete much of your
documentation with minimal typing. This will include specialized documentation tools and content for both adult and
pediatric patients. (Quick Start Guide will be available to users in UTHP Train Tracks)
User Efficiency
Note: Pediatric patients will have a Neuro Exam Tab available for documentation
with pediatric specific forms available.
Gold Star Item
Neuro Exam Activity improved forms to include:
• Mental Status
• Cranial Nerves
• Motor
• Sensory
• Reflexes
• Coordination
• Gait

text:
ProcDoc- Dermatology
You will now be able to use Procedure NoteWriter forms to standardize and speed up certain procedure documentation. By
typing “.procdoc” in a note (or if available, a Procedures button may already be built in your Notes Activity), you will be able to
select the procedure you want to document on by filling in the form using speed buttons and free text. This automatically fills
in your progress note, orders are placed and signed, & appropriate charges are dropped.
New Workflow
Skin Removal/Mole Removal
Procedure will
be selected.
Form will be filled out
using speed buttons and
free text to complete
progress note and for
appropriated charges to
drop.

New Workflow
Insertion/Removal

There are 3 options
that were

charges to drop.

Request a Change to Procedure Length
See expected case length and request changes to the length of procedures, using historical information about
the length of past cases to help you decide how much time you need when deviations from the expected case
length are necessary.
Try It Out
1. To request a change to the procedure time while creating your case request, click the pencil icon
next to the current procedure time.
2. Hover over this editable field to see how much time you usually take for this procedure so you can
consider how you might need to adjust if there are special circumstances. You can also review how
confident the system is that the original calculated procedure length is accurate.
3. Enter your new requested procedure length in the editable field.
4. Optionally, add comments in the Requested Length Comments field to explain your request.
Schedulers can see these comments when reviewing your requested procedure length changes.

When you contact a patient about an outreach task, choose a more descriptive task outcome from a list of

see task outcomes without looking through your task comments, and you can more easily identify tasks that still
need follow-up. Positive outcomes, like Completed Successfully, appear with a green check, and negative
outcomes, like Unable to Reach, appear with a yellow dash.

text:
New Feature
Introducing: Last Impactable Date
Outreach reports now show the patient's Last Impactable Date—sometimes called the point of no return or
absolute fail date—so you can prioritize outreach to patients with the soonest Last Impactable Date. After this
date, the patient is considered non-adherent for the year because they were not adherent to their medication
therapy for too many days. If you get medications in the patient's hands before that date, they still have a
chance of meeting the quality measure adherence goal for the year.

Picture
In your outreach reports, a patient's medication adherence care
gap status and PDC now includes the latest data from
supplemental dispenses, which lets you address the most relevant
topics when performing outreaches. Hover to discover whether it
includes supplemental dispense information, or find out more
details in the Medication Adherence Care Gaps print group.

Improve Adherence Outcomes in Workqueues
Use your value-based care gap workqueues to get patients the medications they need and improve your
organization's performance on medication adherence measures. Note the following new details in your
workqueue reports:
1. The last impactable date shows the last day on which the patient can receive the medication and remain
adherent for the measure this year.
2. The Calculated PDC shows the patient's proportion of days covered based on both data from your payer
and dispense data from your system.
3. The payer-specific PDC shows just the data from your payer.

text:
Get to Know the New Health Maintenance
Health Maintenance now shows you more relevant information and makes it easier for you to answer patient
questions and find the care gaps you’re responsible for closing. Use this tip sheet to understand how to find
the information you need and where to see more details.
Find and Close Relevant Care Gaps
When you first open Health Maintenance, the patient’s care gaps are sorted so that their current care gaps
appear first, followed by any tentatively due topics that need your review. Then, you see topics where
relevant care has already been scheduled, upcoming care gaps, and closed care gaps.
To adjust which topics you see:
1. In the toolbar, review the Sort by and Filter to options.
2. To get a better sense for what care the patient needs right now, click Needs Attention. Depending on
your specialty, you might see an additional checkbox that limits your view to topics you can address.
3. To help structure your conversation with the patient, click Group to see similar care gaps next to each
other. For example, see immunizations and screenings separately so that you can show the patient
what care they can receive in the clinic today and what care might need to be scheduled elsewhere.
4. If the patient asks about a specific care gap, click Name to see an alphabetized list that helps you find
the topic quickly.
5. When you’re ready to act, click Close Care Gaps to create a SmartSet containing orders for the
patient’s outstanding care gaps. This button creates the same SmartSet you can create from the Care
Gaps section in Storyboard.

text:
5. When you’re ready to act, click Close Care Gaps to create a SmartSet containing orders for the
patient’s outstanding care gaps. This button creates the same SmartSet you can create from the Care
Gaps section in Storyboard.
6. Not ready to close all care gaps? Click Place Order next to the topics you’re ready to address.

a. Why the patient qualifies for the topic.
b. How often the topic needs to be addressed.
c. Information about relevant care the patient received in the past.
2. For topics with additional criteria, click Advanced Rule Criteria to see detailed information about why
the patient qualifies.

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Annotate Events in SlicerDicer
Quickly annotate key events on line graphs in SlicerDicer to explain changes in trends, such as an increase in
vaccination rates after the start of a vaccine outreach program. To add an annotation, right-click on the line
graph, select Events, then Add Event. To edit events, click on the edit icon in the hover bubble that appears
when you hover over the event.
Key Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Publish Reporting Workbench Visualizations to Your
Dashboards
Keep a closer eye on the visualizations you create in Reporting Workbench by publishing those visualizations to
your personal dashboard, where you can more easily access them along with other reporting content that's
meaningful to you. The new Create Component option is available when you open your dashboard view in
Designer UI, sometimes called edit model.
Key Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Additional Changes
Return to Table of Contents

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Explore the Relationship Between Heart Rate and
Other Factors
Use the Heart Rate filter in the following data models to explore hunches related to how factors such as
medications, diagnoses, or demographics like age affect heart rate: Anesthesia Records, Blood Product
Administration, Patients, Patients with Cancer, and Perfusion Records. You can find the Heart Rate filter in the
Vitals folder of those data models.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
New Filters to Explore Data in SlicerDicer Dashboard
Components
Additional filters are now available in many of your SlicerDicer components to help you drill down and explore
your data in new ways. You can use the following filters as dashboard parameters: encounter payer, encounter
type, ethnicity, immunizations, language, PCP department specialty, PCP specialty, procedure ID, and state.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Find Extraordinary Values in SlicerDicer
You can now increase the maximum value and decrease the
minimum value for numeric search filters in SlicerDicer to find
examples that are out of the ordinary. On the number slider, click
the maximum or minimum value and change the value by either
entering a new value or clicking the arrow to decrease or increase
it.
For example, most babies are no more than 24 inches long at
birth, but you might be interested in reviewing data for babies that
exceed that birth length. Or you might want to find the small
number of patients whose results for labs such as ALT and AST are
exponentially higher than average.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Create Sequential and Overlapping Chains in Most
Data Models
You can now build sequential and overlapping event chains in nearly all SlicerDicer data models. You can also
create sequential or overlapping chains directly from the Browse button. Select the data model name under the
Sequentials header to use data model events, like Hospital Admissions, in your comparisons. For example, you
can now filter your results to only readmissions in the Hospital Admissions data model.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Conditional Top and Bottom N Slices
You can now filter out slices that do not meet simple criteria when taking Top or Bottom N slices. To do so, click
Add Criterion to add a slice criteria. Then grab Top or Bottom N slices. By default, the Limit Your Slice Results
section is collapsed. To expand, click the chevron that is to the right of the Limit Your Slice Results text.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Geolocation Filters for More SlicerDicer Data Models
New filters make it easier for you to visualize and report on patients and events based on where patients live or
where events occurred. After you filter the session to include the patients or events you want to report on, in the
Visual Options section, click the map option, and target a specific Boundary Type and Location Source.
For example, you can determine which counties might benefit most from additional outreach for food insecurity
by filtering the BPA data model to show the counties in which the patients for whom your food insecurity BPA
appears.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Share Dashboards Using Secure Chat
More easily collaborate with others using Secure Chat to share and
send links to dashboards. From the dashboard you want to share,
click the share icon (1) at the top-right corner of the activity. Then,
click either Secure Chat to send a link to the dashboard along
with your message or Grant Access (2) to give access to users who
do not already have access to the dashboard.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Organize Your Tagged Reports
If you create your own report tags in the Analytics Catalog, you
can now organize them however you like. Private tags make it
possible for you to categorize the reports you use by concepts you
define, such as how often you run them.
To organize your private tags and the reports within them, select
Edit my tags, and use the arrows or drag and drop your tags or
reports.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Easier Data Model Updates with Data Gateway
Data Gateway now pulls in customizations you've made to previous imports, which you can then choose to
reapply when you upload a new file version for your data model, so that your data model always reflects the
most up-to-date information without you needing to reapply your data model settings each month.
Select Yes to reuse an existing data model and then make adjustments as necessary before you import the
updated file. After your file is mapped to an existing data model, review the Similarity Score and any columns
that couldn't be mapped automatically. A score of Perfect means all columns were mapped. A score of None or
Poor means you likely need to create a new data model instead of reimporting into this one.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Components Are Easier to Find in the Analytics
Catalog
New images appear for dashboard components in the catalog so that you can quickly find the bar graph, line
graph, or other visualization type you're looking for without opening the entries.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Control More Components Using the Dashboard's
Date Range
To make it easier for you to review data from the same time period in your dashboard components, you can now
use the dashboard's date range setting to update the dates used by report-based components. Before changing
the date range, hover over the setting to see which components are controlled by that setting. Components that
will be updated are highlighted using colored borders.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Export Dashboard Data to Excel
You can now export data from certain dashboards and their components into Excel for further analysis and
review using the new Export Component and Export Dashboard options in the menu.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Share Saved Report Results with Other Users
Share saved report results with other users right from the Save Results window. Sharing results lets you all review
the same information, without granting other users access to your private reports. You can also send those users
a quick In Basket message. If needed, you can modify access to and the expiration date of the results you've
shared at any time by returning to the Save Results window.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:

title: Cogito Upgrade Training Slides-May 2024
text:
Do More Using Advanced Formulas in SlicerDicer
All SlicerDicer data models now support using conditional IF statements in the formulas you create to evaluate
measures, giving you the flexibility to explore your data in new and more complex ways. For example, you might
use an IF statement to compare the average number of vaccine doses between documented administrations and
Health Maintenance and have the higher value returned. Hover over the info icon after the Formula field for
information about how to properly format your IF statements.
If You Have Time
New Feature

Explore More Staff and Metric Data in
SlicerDicer
Use new SlicerDicer filters to report on a variety of measures related to anesthesia procedures, including how
quickly records are signed and documentation is finished, how well you're meeting various compliance
measures, and which staff members were present at anesthesia start and stop times.
Try It Out
The new filters are available in the Anesthesia Records data model, and there's one new filter in the Perfusion
Procedure data model. We'll give you an overview of what's available in each folder, and we recommend that
you explore for yourself in the system to see what you'll find most useful.
One possible use of the new filters, a graph showing percentage of anesthesia records that are compliant and
qualified for the Train of Four Measurement.
The folders with new filters include:
 Billing: A new filter tracks the total cost of medications administered intraprocedure.
 Compliance: These filters measure compliance with various questions, letting you see how often your
organization is compliant with everything from Train of Four measurement to instructing patients not
to smoke.
 Dates and Times: When you're viewing the data as a table, add these columns to track the progress of
documentation by showing when various steps in your documentation were completed, such as a
when a postprocedure note was created or a record was signed.
 Duration: These filters track the length of time it took to reach certain steps in documentation.
 Procedure: These filters let you see how many procedures of a certain type you have.

text:

 Procedure: These filters let you see how many procedures of a certain type you have.

and stop of anesthesia procedures. Note that the Staff Type (A) filter is also available for the Perfusion
