title: InBasket Categorization Tip Sheet
text:
© 2024 Epic Systems Corporation. Confidential.
In Basket Categorization
Messages from patients can cover a variety of topics, such as medication question, Lab results, etc. To help
you quickly identify and work through patient advice messages, the system now uses machine learning that
analyzes the text of the message and automatically assigns a category to the message.
Filtering Pool Messages Based on Category
To find messages that are automatically categorized use a filter
on the Categories column.
1. Open the In Basket MyChart Advice Request folder and
click Filter in the toolbar.
2. Select Filter By Value > Category.
3. In the Filter by Category window, select the categories you
want to filter on (example below):
• Clinical users should select Clinical - General and COVID-
19. • Support staff should select the Exclude Values checkbox
and then select Clinical - General and COVID-19. If you
identify any messages that should be categorized as Clinical
- General or COVID-19, apply the category using the steps in
the next topic.
Review and Update a Category
Open In Basket and select the MyChart Advice Request folder. Open a message. At the top (or close to the
top), review the categories. If the category is inaccurate, you can click the X to remove it.
(Note that if the category was
added automatically by the
system, that information
appears in the tooltip. If it
was added by a care team
member, that person’s name
appears.)

title: InBasket Categorization Tip Sheet
text:
© 2024 Epic Systems Corporation. Confidential.
If you are forwarding the message to someone else to address, you can help them by selecting a more specific
category by completing the following steps.
1. Click Help to review
definitions for all of the
available categories. Many are
intuitively named, but if you're
not sure what's different about
the Advice Request and
Medication DDI category, for
example, this help screen has
the details.
2. If you want to add
additional categories, click
the Add categories header to
view a list of available options.
3. Click the appropriate
buttons to add the categories.
Understanding Machine Learning
Machine learning is an evolving technology that can help assist you in your workflows. However, it is not perfect.
We expect the system to be able to detect messages that require some sort of clinical action, such as requesting
a refill, asking about a lab result, or getting advice about an injury or illness with a high degree of accuracy
(greater than 80% of the time).
However, some messages that require clinical actions might not be labeled with the category and some
messages labeled with a Clinical category might not require a clinical follow-up.
The system should have a similar degree of accuracy (greater than 90%) when identifying FYI messages, which
likely do not require any action and can be marked as Done. Remember that these broad categories are a useful
first step to help you get through your In Basket faster.

title: Rapid Retest
text: Rapid Retest

title: Rapid Retest
text:
Rapid Retest
Overview
Rapid Retest is an Epic feature that accelerates the resolution of Clearinghouse edits by enabling quick retesting
of claims.
Benefits
• Fast Resolution: Quickly resolve Clearinghouse edits without nightly delays.
• Increased Efficiency: Refresh claims in workqueues to identify resolved errors.
• Reduced A/R Days: Speeds up payments and decreases accounts receivable time.
• Quick Refresh: Initial refresh takes 2-3 minutes, with future updates targeting ~10 seconds.
Time Saver

title: Cash Management
text: Cash Management

title: Cash Management
text:
Awareness
Cash Management
Overview
Cash Management helps your organization reconcile bank cash with payments in Epic. It uses
bank deposit information to create cash records that match corresponding payments in Epic,
ensuring all payments align with cash on hand.
Benefits
• Easier reconciliation of bank deposits and Epic payments ensures accurate and up-to-
date AR.
• Automatic linking of payments and deposits simplifies deposit identification.
• Improved efficiency and accuracy in payment posting, as batches from cash control
groups include all necessary details like check reference number, payer, deposit date, and
amount.

MyChart Instant Activation
Epic automatically sends Instant Activation Messages via Email or SMS for Key Events
This reduces the work of front desk and clinic staff by automatically sending instant activation messages for key
events, including the following:
 Appointment Scheduled - Sends Auto Instant Activation on Appt Scheduled
 Check In - Sends Auto Instant Activation on Check In
 Check Out - Sends Auto Instant Activation on Check Out
 Discharge - Sends Auto Instant Activation on Discharge
 Triage Call - Sends Auto Instant Activation on Care Advice Given During Triage Call
Quick Win

text:
Hello World Billing Notifications
New Feature
Overview
Billing notifications are relevant for both Professional Billing (PB) and Hospital Billing
(HB), sent to patients for any financial event, such as new bills or estimates.

title: Hello World
text:
Hello World Billing Notifications
New Feature
Hello World offers the option to opt in or opt out of notifications. Users can
choose how they receive notifications. This allows patients to make their own
decisions about how they prefer to receive notifications, ensuring they aren’t
overwhelmed with communication.

title: Lab Order Changes
text:
Continued on next page.© 2024 Epic Systems Corporation. Confidential.
Lab Order Changes
With the Epic Beaker (lab) implementation, lab orders will have an updated look. The images below display the
current state Epic Procedure/Order window, and future state changes that will display starting on December
10, 2024 .
Review the information below for more details about the upcoming changes.
• Class field options are Clinic
Collect or Lab Collect.
- Clinic Collect is for in-house
(clinic) draws.
- Lab Collect is for draw stations
(MSRH) or external labs
(Labcorp, Quest, or UHS).
• Resulting Agency appears
and auto defaults to MSRH,
Labcorp, Quest or UHS based
on insurance. Manual changes
can also be made if needed.
- Resulting agency is the facility
where the patient will go to
have a lab completed or where
the clinic collected specimen will
be sent for resulting.
Note: Patient insurance &
coverage must be current and
verified for the appropriate
Resulting Agency to default in
the order.

title: Lab Order Changes
text:
Continued on next page.
Definitions for Lab Procedure Order Settings for Ambulatory-Beaker
NOTE: This tip sheet does NOT apply to oncology ambulatory settings.
Status is not changing with Beaker
Status Definition Example
Future Used for orders that a clinician does not act
on during the encounter, such as lab test to
be drawn at a future date.
Should not be chosen in combination with a
class of Clinic Collect.
A fasting glucose test to be collected later.
Standing Used for orders that a clinician places in one
encounter but will be performed multiple
times sometime in the future.
Should not be chosen in combination with a
class of Clinic Collect.
Liver function test every 3 months.
Normal Used for orders that a clinician acts on
during the encounter, such as a point-of-care
urine pregnancy test.
A urine sample collected in clinic.

text:
Focus on Tasks Due Soon in the Narrator
Tasks that aren't due in the next hour are
tucked away in a Due Later group (A) in the
Tasks section of the Narrator so you can
focus on what your patient needs next.
Expand the group (B) if you need to
preview upcoming tasks.
As time passes, tasks move automatically
from the Due Later group to the
appropriate category group, like
Documentation or Labs. If you want tasks
to move out of the Due Later group sooner
or later than 60 minutes before their due
time, click the wrench icon in the Narrator
toolbar to adjust that threshold.
Additional Changes

text:
Pause Home Medications at Discharge
If a patient should temporarily stop taking
one of their home medications after they
leave the ACC, you can pause the
medication from the Prescriptions &
Orders section of the Dispo activity. Click
Pause (A) and either indicate a specific date
and time for the patient to resume taking
the medication (B) or pause it indefinitely
(C). Add instructions for the patient (D) and
let other providers, like the patient's PCP,
know why you're pausing the medication
(E).
Patients see information about the paused
medication on their AVS.
Tip Sheet: Pause Home Medications at DischargeKey Changes

text:
More Accurate Opioid Prescribing Data
You might notice higher numbers on your Opioid Prescribing Scorecard because metrics now include opioid
orders that are placed, distributed to the patient, and then later discontinued. For example, if a patient leaves the
ACC with an opioid prescription and her PCP discontinues it at a follow-up appointment because the patient no
longer reports pain, that order was previously not included in your scorecard. Now it is, so the numbers might
go up.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

Reach Out When a Patient Is Interested in SDOH
Assistance
Now that patients can indicate when they want assistance
addressing SDOH, look for the hands heart icon to know when you
should talk with them about resources.
When a domain's risk color goes all the way to the center (A), a
patient has said they want assistance for that domain. For this
patient, those domains are Alcohol Use and Social Connections.
When you hover over a domain (B), the icon appears in the upper
right corner and indicates whether assistance was requested or
declined.

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#3
text:
Pause Home Medications At Discharge
You can now pause a patient's prescription during discharge medication reconciliation, avoiding the need to
modify those prescriptions or rely on ad hoc instructions to the patient. Just click the new Pause button (1), enter
pause details in the Order Composer (2), and review the AVS preview of your pause (3).
Press Pause on a Patient's Home Medications at DischargeAdditional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#4
text:
Indicate Whether Held Duration-Based Medications
Should Be Stopped or Removed Immediately
To help nurses know exactly when to remove an active duration-based medication that you're placing on hold,
indicate whether it should be stopped immediately or removed after the current administration is complete. This
includes duration-based medications with a frequency other than Continuous, such as patches and IV
Piggybacks.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#5
text:
Acknowledge Critical Results from Push Notifications
Push notifications in Hyperspace, Rover, Haiku, or Canto keep you of aware critical results for your patients when
you're on the go. You can acknowledge the result directly from the notification and save the phone call for when
you need additional information.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#6
text:
Acknowledge and Send Critical Results Through
Secure Chat
You can now acknowledge a critical result directly from a Secure Chat message and draft a Secure Chat message
from a critical result notification.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#7
text:
Search Keywords to Find Summarized Patient Data
Search a patient's chart for terms related to any of these topics
using the Epic search bar to see new summaries about the
patient's medications, devices, tasks to complete, and who's caring
for the patient or in the unit:
• Continuous, Infusion, PRN, Overdue, or Scheduled Medications
• MAR Admin History and Blood History
• Intake/Output or Net Intake/Output
• Device Associations
• Flowsheets Needing Cosign
• Patient Tasks
• Admission or Discharge Required Documentation
• Attending, Admitting, or Signed-in Providers
• Next or All Assignments
• Review Treatment Team
• Unit Stats
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#8
text:
Find a Patient's Location Faster
Chart Search for "current location" or "patient location" to see the patient's location history.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#9
text:
Organize To-Dos in Handoff Report
Use the provider Handoff to share specific to-dos as tasks that
members of your patient’s care team can check off, transfer, and
track with a click or two instead of using a text box.
Organize To-Dos in HandoffAdditional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#10
text:
Add American Cancer Society Educational Materials
to the AVS
Send patients home with reference materials approved by the American Cancer Society (ACS) in their After Visit
Summary in their primary language to help them understand their cancer diagnosis and navigate their
treatment journey.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#11
text:
Automatic Calculations for Medication Quantities
Choose the number of days you want to fill a medication for, and the quantity you need to order appears
automatically—no need to enter a duration first.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#12
text:
Review Previous Hospital Orders When Admitting
Patients
Orders from previous admissions appear in the side-by-side admission medication reconciliation view, and you
can reorder them if needed—but you don't need to address these orders to complete reconciliation.
Hospital orders from previous admissions are shaded gray and marked with an icon of a hospital with a return
arrow.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#13
text:
Change the Same Details for Multiple Orders at Once
If you find yourself regularly making the same change to all the
orders when you’re placing multiple lab, imaging, or medication
orders, save clicks and time by using a macro. To create a macro,
click the Macro Manager button from the Edit Multiple window,
enter the values you commonly apply to orders, and save them.
You can then use the macro from any ordering activity with the
Edit Multiple option.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#14
text:
A Cleaner View of Results
Results stand out more clearly in In Basket and Chart Review now that reference ranges are visible in a hover
bubble instead of next to the result values. To add them back, open your personalization settings and select
Show Ref Range on hover.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#15
text:
Delete Problems in the Edit Problem Window for
Inpatient Diagnosis Aware Notes
The Delete Problem button now appears in the Edit Problem window. This button deletes a Problem from both
the clinician's note and the patient's Problem List. If clinicians want to remove the problem from the note but not
the patient's Problem List, they can use the Remove from Note button in the pencil menu of Diagnosis-Aware
Notes.
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#16
text:
Add Multiple Codes to Procedures in Case Entry
For more flexible and precise documentation, you can add multiple codes to a procedure in Case Entry. If you
previously used workarounds to document multiple codes, you can now complete that documentation as part of
the Case Entry workflow.
Add Multiple Codes a Procedure in Case EntryNovember 2022
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#17
text:
Edit Newly Signed Orders in Side-by-Side Admission
New Feature
Within the Admission Order Reconciliation, providers can modify or discontinue prior to admission
medications after signing them for admission without having to navigate to the Orders activity.

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Orders Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#18
text:
Result Notes: Now on Mobile
Take action on result notes in In Basket while on call or away from
your workstation on your iOS or Android device.
Additional Changes
New Feature

Document Patient Interest in SDOH Assistance
Make sure that patients who want help get it by filling out two new questions in the Follow-Ups section when
you document their social drivers of health.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#4
text:
Reach Out When a Patient Is Interested in SDOH
Assistance
Now that patients can indicate when they want assistance
addressing SDOH, look for the hands heart icon to know when you
should talk with them about resources.
When a domain's risk color goes all the way to the center (A), a
patient has said they want assistance for that domain. For this
patient, those domains are Alcohol Use and Social Connections.
When you hover over a domain (B), the icon appears in the upper
right corner and indicates whether assistance was requested or
declined.
Key Changes
New Feature

text:
Explore Flowsheet Documentation Data in SlicerDicer
Answer questions about documented flowsheet values, like which departments are struggling to document in
real time, or which departments are making the best use of flowsheet macros, without needing to send a report
request to your IT team.
View Tip SheetAdditional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#7
text:
Extreme Makeover: Discharge Planning Edition
Quickly find the information you need with indicators that summarize a patient's discharge status and new
sorting and filtering options. Hover over the History column to see the history of a milestone or delay.
Cross-Role Updates
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

text:
Search Keywords to Find Summarized Patient Data
While in the Epic Search bar use terms related to any of these
topics to see new summaries about the patient's medications,
devices, tasks to complete, and who's caring for the patient or in
the unit:
• Continuous, Infusion, PRN, Overdue, or Scheduled Medications
• MAR Admin History and Blood History
• Intake/Output or Net Intake/Output
• Device Associations
• Flowsheets Needing Cosign
• Patient Tasks
• Admission or Discharge Required Documentation
• Attending, Admitting, or Signed-in Providers
• Next or All Assignments
• Review Treatment Team
• Unit Stats
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

text:
Find a Patient's Location Faster
In Epic Search type "current location" or "patient location" to see the patient's location history.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#10
text:
Quickly Find Episodes, Goals, and Diagnoses in Search
When you search for active episodes, patient goals, or visit diagnoses, new spotlight cards appear to show you
information related to your search without the need to jump to a different activity.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#11
text:
Tuck Away Rarely Used Toolbar Buttons
Simplify your toolbars by moving buttons that you don't typically
use to the Dots menu. Right-click on a toolbar button and select
(1) Move to Rarely Used to move it to (2) the Dots menu.
Not all toolbars have a Dots menu, but many common activities
do, including Chart Review and Patient Lists.
Additional Changes
Quick Win
View Tip Sheet

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#12
text:
See More About a Patient's Intake and Output
See more detailed information about a patient's intake and output by using expanding and collapsing arrows or
hovering over a value to see more about it, like specific time information and behind-the scenes calculations.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#13
text:
Assess Gender Dysphoria Using the GIDYQ-AA
Assess whether, and to what degree, adult and
adolescent patients experience gender dysphoria using
the Gender Identity/Gender Dysphoria Questionnaire
for Adolescents and Adults (GIDYQ-AA). Your
organization might have made this questionnaire
available for you to administer from a section in a
navigator such as Assessments or in the Flowsheets
activity. Your organization might also have made it
available for patients to complete in MyChart or at
check-in, and you can review responses from either the
Visit Navigator or an In Basket message.
View Tip SheetAdditional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#14
text:
Hold Units Accountable for ICU Liberation
Compliance
See compliance with the ICU Liberation Bundle overall in a single metric, alongside metrics for each bundle
element, so you have the data you need to follow up with clinicians about adjusting assessment or
documentation workflows. You can also investigate ICU data further in SlicerDicer, without needing to send IT a
report request.
View Tip SheetAdditional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#15
text:
Change Disciplines in Care Plan Goals and
Interventions
If you’re adding a care plan goal or intervention with a general default discipline, such as Interdisciplinary,
and you need to update it with the specific discipline of the clinician who’ll work with the patient, you can now
add or change values in the Disciplines field.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#16
text: Additional Changes: Nurse Updates

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#17
text:
Simplify Medication Administrations with Flowsheet
Cascading
When you need to document additional details for an administration, such as a pain score, you see just the
flowsheet rows you need to complete based on your documentation, like in other places you document
flowsheets.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#18
text:
Document Similar Administrations at the Same Time
When you're giving multiple similar medications to a patient, scan the second medication right from the same
administration form and use the Select an Order window to choose that you're documenting the second
medication and not increasing the first medication's dose. Before, you needed to finish the first administration
and document the second one separately.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#19
text:
See Reminders to Document Finished Infusions
For some infusions, timely documentation is extra-important for accurate total volume calculations and
reimbursement for the care. In those cases, a due time is automatically queued up for you in the MAR as a
reminder to document the stopped time.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#20
text:
New Wound Types Allow for More Precise
Documentation
Document more specific wound types wound types on the avatar with new primary and secondary types.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#21
text:
Report on More Specific Wound Types
Use dashboards, SlicerDicer, or Reporting Workbench to report on new, more granular wound types that
clinicians document. For example, see the number of wounds of each primary and secondary type your
department is treating.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#22
text:
Mark Wounds as Duplicates
When multiple wounds documented on the Avatar represent the same wound on the patient, use the new
Duplicate outcome to remove the extra wound from the Avatar.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#23
text:
Delete Incorrect Flowsheet Documentation Faster
If you notice incorrect flowsheet data filed to the Event Log in a narrator, quickly delete it by clicking the X to
the right instead of opening the event and clearing the data row by row.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#24
text:
Old Blood Transfusions Are Automatically Completed
Lingering incomplete transfusions are hidden in Flowsheets after 24 hours, but that's no replacement for your
accurate, timely documentation about how long the transfusion ran, so continue to document when you stop
and complete transfusions. A note shows you when a transfusion was completed automatically by the system.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf
title: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai

meta.file: EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Inpatient Clinical Documentation Upgrade Trai.pdf#25
text:
Continuous Orders Are Discontinued When They
Expire
Orders that have continuous frequencies—such as restraints or telemetry—are now automatically discontinued
after they expire, so you don't have to remove them manually or check to see whether the time period has
expired to determine whether to act on them.
On the Active Orders tab, you can reorder procedures that were recently automatically discontinued, the same
way you do other expired orders.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

text:
Focus on Tasks Due Soon in the Narrator
Tasks that aren't due in the next hour are
tucked away in a Due Later group (A) in the
Tasks section of the Narrator so you can
focus on what your patient needs next.
Expand the group (B) if you need to
preview upcoming tasks.
As time passes, tasks move automatically
from the Due Later group to the
appropriate category group, like
Documentation or Labs. If you want tasks
to move out of the Due Later group sooner
or later than 60 minutes before their due
time, click the wrench icon in the Narrator
toolbar to adjust that threshold.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

Devices

consent documents, edit any fields within the e-signature template,

Treatment Plans
Dental students no longer need to have a faculty member log in and modify approved treatment plans for them.
Instead, students can make their own changes and then ask their faculty member to view them on the student's
workstation. The faculty member can review and approve or revert the student's changes.

text:
Merge Visits More Easily
Save a click when you merge two visits from the same treatment plan into today's visit.
Imagine that you planned to do a filling on tooth 3 today and on tooth 13 in a second visit. When the patient
comes in, he indicates tooth 13 is bothering him and needs attention today. When you select Visit 2 from the
Treatment Plans section and move it to the Today section, the filling on tooth 13 becomes part of visit Visit 1 and
Visit 2 is automatically deleted.
Time Saver

text:
Analyze Scheduling Turnaround Time for Imaging
Orders with SlicerDicer
Analyze scheduling turnaround times for imaging orders with new filters that slice orders based on how long it
took to schedule the exam once the order was placed, the time between scheduling the exam and the exam
actually occurring, and the time between when the order was placed and when the exam was scheduled. Use
these filters on their own to evaluate efficiency and optimize your department's resources or combine them with
other filters to compare efficiency across departments, modalities, and providers.

Now, patients can send research study messages for studies shown in MyChart that they're associated with. For
example, a patient might have a question for their study coordinator about an investigational medication refill or
rescheduling an appointment.

the Pt Advice Requests folder.

text:
Manage Your Own Patient-Facing Study Descriptions
The research regulatory staff would be able to create and edit patient-facing study description SmartTexts,
eliminating the need for the IT team to own the build and migration of these SmartTexts.
In your production environment, go to Study Maintenance and open the study you want to create or update a
description for. Select the MyChart Settings tab (2). Use the Edit Description or Create New button next to the
Default Patient-Facing Description field or Patient-Facing Description Overrides table (3).

If necessary, you can change the number of technicians required on an in-progress job using the Request Editor,
provided the job doesn't have any completed assignments and the required technicians isn't changed to fewer
than originally requested.

SlicerDicer
In SlicerDicer, when you're digging into data about transfer center requests, you can now filter the population of
requests by whether they were cancelled. You can then slice by things like department to find out which
departments accept the most requests.

title: Cogito Upgrade August 2024
text:
Cogito Upgrade

Epic Version August 2024

title: Cogito Upgrade August 2024
text:
Supplement SlicerDicer with Real-Time Data
After you create a session in SlicerDicer, you can now open the report viewer within SlicerDicer to review
additional, real-time data for the records you're reporting on for many data models. To do so, click the detail
table option in the Visual Options section, select a row in the detail table, and click the arrow at the bottom of
the screen to open the report reviewer.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade August 2024
text:
Easier Access to Demographic Information in
SlicerDicer
A larger and more consistent set of demographic information is now available in the Patient Demographics
folder of nearly all data models. This will allow users to filter by more demographical information without having
to use data model linking, saving time within the session.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

title: Cogito Upgrade August 2024
text:
Safely Share Your Dashboard View with Others
Do you have personal dashboard views that others would find helpful or that help tell your story with the data?
You can now share them in a read-only view, so others can see what you see, while your configuration is
protected. Within a dashboard, click the share button and choose whether to grant direct access to the
dashboard view, send a link to it in Secure Chat, or generate a URL to send to another user.
Additional Changes
New Feature

title: Cogito Upgrade August 2024
text:
Make More Meaningful Comparisons in Dashboards
When you're investigating historical trends using a dashboard, the new To-Date Comparison (1) option that’s
available in Comparison View lets you compare the current period to an equivalent period in the past. If
appropriate for your data set, click Exclude Weekends (2) to compare more similar intervals after selecting the
To-Date Comparison option.
Additional Changes
New Feature

text:
Updated Terminology in Telephone Encounters
“This Conversation” is the new name for the “Call Intake” activity used in telephone, refill, and other call-related
encounters so that it shares terminology with other types of encounters that also focus on communication with
a patient, such as result follow-up and patient message encounters. Also, "Reason for Conversation" is the new
name for the Reason for Call section, "Review" is the new name for the This Call sidebar summary activity, and
"Conversation Summary" is the new name for the Call Summary report.
Additional Changes
New Look
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#4
text:
Complete Results Follow-Ups in One Place
When you act on a result message from In Basket, a new Results Follow-Up workspace opens with all the
activities you need to release results to MyChart, send a patient message, document a call, or write a letter.
Routing from the new Result Follow-Up encounter always sends as a Result Notes message instead of a Patient
Call or other message type. Because Result Notes messages always show the linked results, you don't need to
include the results in your text using the .IBRSLT or other SmartLinks.
Additional Changes
New Look
In Basket Result Management Tip Sheet
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Physicians

text:
Use Storyboard for MyChart Signup
Activate patients’ MyChart accounts using the MyChart Status button in the Storyboard, now that the MyChart
Signup navigator section is retired.
Additional Changes
New Workflow
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Front Desk Staff
• Registrar

text:
Document Patient Interest in SDOH Assistance
Make sure that patients who want help get it by filling out two new questions in the Follow-Ups section when
you document their social drivers of health.
Key Changes
New Feature
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Physician
• Social Worker
• Care Coordinator

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Reach Out When a Patient Is Interested in SDOH
Assistance
Now that patients can indicate when they want assistance
addressing SDOH, look for the hands heart icon to know when you
should talk with them about resources.
When a domain's risk color goes all the way to the center (A), a
patient has said they want assistance for that domain. For this
patient, those domains are Alcohol Use and Social Connections.
When you hover over a domain (B), the icon appears in the upper
right corner and indicates whether assistance was requested or
declined.
Key Changes
New Feature
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Physician
• Social Worker
• Care Coordinator
• Outreach Specialists

text:
SDOH Specifics from Anywhere in the Chart
Hover over a social driver of health in Storyboard to see specifics
for that domain, just like what you see when you hover over a
domain in the SDOH Wheel. Recent concerns and assistance
requested both show only the relevant domains. Hover over Social
Drivers to see the familiar bird’s eye view of all domains.
Additional Changes
New Look
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Outpatient
Physician
• Social Worker
• Outreach Specialists
• Care Coordinator

text:
Collapse Lesser-Used Navigator Sections
Simplify your screen by tucking away navigator
sections that you don't use during most visits.
(1) Expand or collapse the section by clicking
anywhere in the section header, and (2) choose
whether to collapse the section automatically
using the checkbox. (3) You can also view
notifications for relevant updates in the collapsed
section.
Note that collapsing sections is currently
available in the Plan, Wrap-Up, This Visit, and
Pre-Charting activities used in outpatient visits
and in the Take Action activity used in telephone
encounters.
Key Changes
Quick Win

text:
See Genomic Result PDFs Without an Extra Click
When you view genomic results in In Basket or Chart Review, the
attached PDF with the lab details is right on the screen so you
don’t have to click to open it each time.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

text:
Pend SmartSets to Finish Later
If you need to step away, or if someone else is going to pick up where you left off, click Pend to save a SmartSet
for later. Pended SmartSets appear in the Visit Taskbar and in the SmartSets section of the Orders activity. Click a
pended SmartSet to review, sign, or discard its orders.
Key Changes
Time Saver
Users Impacted:
• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Physician

Expand and Collapse the Checklist to Find Tasks Easily
More easily find the checklist tasks you're looking for by
expanding or collapsing groups of tasks like consults,
documentation, imaging, labs, and letters.
Key Changes
New Feature

text:
Send Responses to Result Notes to Pools
Keep results follow-ups moving by routing responses to your
result note to a pool so that replies from the patient or other
recipients can be handled by the next available member of your
care team instead of waiting for you to check your In Basket.
Select (1) Use pool for responses and (2) enter a pool in the Pool
for Responses field. You can also set default pool for all your result
notes by clicking click the wrench.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Automatic Calculations for Medication Quantities
Choose the number of days you want to fill a medication for, and the quantity you need to order appears
automatically—no need to enter a duration first.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#16
text:
Quickly Change the Same Details for Multiple Orders
at Once
If you find yourself regularly making the same change to all the
orders when you’re placing multiple lab, imaging, or medication
orders, use a macro to make the updates all at once, saving clicks
and time. To create a macro, click the Macro Manager button
from the Edit Multiple window, enter the values you commonly
apply to orders, and save them. You can then use the macro from
any ordering activity with the Edit Multiple option.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#17
text:
Keep an Eye on In-Progress Care Gaps
From the Storyboard, the clipboard you see when patients have an in-progress order for a Health Maintenance
topic now indicates whether the topic is overdue or due soon, so you can follow up with patients to make sure
they're receiving the necessary care.
Additional Changes
New Look

• Nurses
• Medical Assistants
• Physician
• Outpatient
specialist

Sidebar
Quickly review answers to order-specific questions as you document Imaging and Procedures results.

Time Saver

Find Your Favorite Procedures Faster
Add the procedures you perform most often as favorites in the Storyboard so you can select them faster in the
future. Click the star next to a procedure to add it to or remove it from your favorites.

Time Saver

text:
Find Result Follow-Ups in Chart Review
All follow-ups taken on a lab result—such as MyChart messages, letters, and calls—are now consolidated into a
single Results Follow-Up encounter in Chart Review.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
A Cleaner View of Results
Results stand out more clearly in In Basket and Chart Review now that reference ranges are visible in a hover
bubble instead of next to the result values. To add them back, open your personalization settings and select
Show Ref Range on hover.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Respond to Patient’s Lab Result Questions
Patients can now ask questions in MyChart that are linked to the
result, and that result now appears with the conversation in In
Basket folders.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#24
text:
Assistant Bar Puts Labs in the Spotlight
See recent results and reorder labs faster by typing a lab term, such as "CBC" or "lipid panel," in the Assistant Bar
without first needing to open the Search activity.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#25
text:
Ensure Specimen Documentation Is Complete
You can now select a label printer directly from the Collection activity from Order Inquiry, and you might also be
required to enter a specimen source so you don’t need to go back and add this information later.
Additional Changes
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#26
text:
Complete In Basket Tasks from More Places
Quickly follow up on messages throughout your day from the Task sidebar that now appears in more
workspaces, such as Patient Lists and My Dashboards.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Personalize Your Notes Toolbar
Drag and drop your speed buttons to rearrange them and hide the ones you rarely use.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#28
text:
Tuck Away Rarely Used Toolbar Buttons
Simplify your toolbars by moving buttons that you don't typically
use to the Dots menu. Right-click on a toolbar button and select
(1) Move to Rarely Used to move it to (2) the Dots menu.
Not all toolbars have a Dots menu, but many common activities
do, including Chart Review, In Basket, and Schedule.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#29
text:
Search Keywords to Find Summarized Patient Data
Using Epic Search in a patient's chart use terms related to any of
these topics to see new summaries about the patient's
medications, devices, tasks to complete, and who's caring for the
patient or in the unit:
• Continuous, Infusion, PRN, Overdue, or Scheduled Medications
• MAR Admin History and Blood History
• Intake/Output or Net Intake/Output
• Device Associations
• Flowsheets Needing Cosign
• Patient Tasks
• Admission or Discharge Required Documentation
• Attending, Admitting, or Signed-in Providers
• Next or All Assignments
• Review Treatment Team
• Unit Stats
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#30
text:
Quickly Find Episodes, Goals, and Diagnoses in Search
When using Epic search for active episodes, patient goals, or visit diagnoses, new spotlight cards appear to show
you information related to your search without the need to jump to a different activity.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

Cross-Role Updates

text:
Assess Gender Dysphoria Using the GIDYQ-AA
Assess whether, and to what degree, adult and
adolescent patients experience gender dysphoria using
the Gender Identity/Gender Dysphoria Questionnaire
for Adolescents and Adults (GIDYQ-AA). Your
organization might have made this questionnaire
available for you to administer from a section in a
navigator such as Assessments or in the Flowsheets
activity. Your organization might also have made it
available for patients to complete in MyChart or at
check-in, and you can review responses from either the
Visit Navigator or an In Basket message.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#33
text:
Pregnancy Episode Creation Made Simple
Additional Changes
When you care for a pregnant patient who doesn't yet have a pregnancy episode, you can create the episode
right from the navigator where you document pregnancy plans or dating information without leaving your
workflow to go to another activity.

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024

meta.file: EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#34
text:
Take the New Pregnancy Wheel for a Spin
We’ve made the Pregnancy Wheel easier to
use—you can keep it open while you
document in other activities, and you can
open it for a specific patient, which
automatically pulls in their EDD to use for
the calculations without any manual input
from you.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/EpicCare Ambulatory Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#35
text:
Obstetric Details in the Spotlight
Find the pregnancy or delivery

encounters so that it shares terminology with other types of encounters that also focus on communication with
a patient, such as result follow-up and patient message encounters. Also, Reason for Conversation is the new
name for the Reason for Call section, Review is the new name for the This Call sidebar summary activity, and
Conversation Summary is the new name for the Call Summary report.

11. Updates To Pneumococcal Immunization
Scheduling Rules for CDSi
Let clinicians know about the updated pneumococcal immunization scheduling rules, including changes in age
recommendations, new vaccines, and revised dose schedules.
Awareness
Adults now qualify for pneumococcal vaccines starting at 50 years (previously
65 years).
New Pneumococcal Vaccine Added:
PCV21 (CVX 327) is now supported in the pneumococcal immunization series.
Updated Risk-Based Series:
Risk groups are now split into:
Ages 6–18 years
Ages 19+ years
Adjusted Dose Intervals:
Dose 3 in the Risk 2–5 years 4-dose series no longer requires repetition if
administered less than the recommended eight-week interval from the
previous dose, per updated guidance.

text:
24. Fewer Clicks to Switch Departments
Quickly switch departments from the Recent and Favorites menu
in Hyperspace.
To modify your list of favorite departments, click Edit Favorites and
drag departments from the Recent Departments list into the
Favorite Departments list, or search for other departments using
the Department Search field. You can also add or remove a
favorite department by clicking its star icon or using Shift+Space.
Quick Win

text:
Reduce Documentation Errors with Easier Patient
Verification
Ensure you're completing documentation in the correct patient's chart with the ability to scan a patient for
verification in Intraprocedure. Prominent warnings indicate when you've switched to the chart of an unverified
patient while another patient is verified.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#2
text:
Dive Deeper Into Fresh Gas Flow on the Anesthesia
Sustainability Dashboard
Get a better understanding of fresh gas flow rates with new sections, filters, and sessions on the Anesthesia
Sustainability Dashboard that let you investigate overall, induction, and maintenance flow rates related to your
practice and across your organization.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#3
text:
Advisories Provide Real-Time Decision Support in
Medication Administration
Keep track of important details when administering medications with new real-time advisories that appear when
you scan or document a medication, including Critical Dose Warnings calculated using medication information
or Expired Package advisories that pull information from the barcode of the package you're using.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#4
text:
Stay in the Loop with Mobile Staff Change
Notifications
Haiku helps you keep track of staffing changes during anesthesia procedures even when you're not physically
present by sending you mobile notifications when a handoff relevant to you occurs.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#5
text:
Anesthesia-Specific Status Board Review
Quickly scan new Status Board views on your mobile device that
show you icons indicating the status of Preprocedure and
Postprocedure notes and whether the anesthesia record has been
signed
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#6
text:
Bringing Intake and Output into the Procedure
New documentation tools for intake and output let you record this information as part of the Intraprocedure
activity without having to prematurely jump into the Postprocedure activity, making this documentation part of
your procedural workflow rather than something you record after the fact.
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Blood and Notes Sections Arrive in Procedure at a
Glance
Procedure at a Glance expands to include a Blood section that shows important warnings and information about
blood products and a Notes section that shows the most recent clinical notes.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Anesthesia Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:

Days
Enter held time, unavailable time, and provider messages for multiple days right from your scheduling activity.
Begin to add held time, unavailable time, or a provider message for a provider or slot like you normally would.
Then, click the new Advanced Options button to open the full Add Exceptions window or Add Provider
Messages window, which include date range options.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

Fix mistaken documentation of supplies as implants or vice versa in the Intra-Op Navigator with a button that
allows you to swap between the two in one click without re-entering the item information.

When you enter terms related to procedures in Chart Search, you now see relevant patient information directly
in the search results with several new Spotlight Cards, including cards for counts, case information, staff
instructions, and more.

Quickly scan new Status Board views on your mobile device that
show you icons indicating a patient latex allergy, infection status,
and if a case is an add-on case.

Make faster and more accurate preference card updates with one click of a new button, applying requested
preference card changes directly from the message requesting them.

Quickly scan new Status Board views on your mobile device that
show you icons indicating if a case is an add-on case.

text:

When the panels on a case are in the wrong order, click Rearrange Panels to correct the order instead of having
to delete the panels and add them back.

text:
Add and Delete Exceptions for Multiple Providers
Instead of searching for individual providers, you can now search for a subgroup or department to add and
delete exceptions (held time or unavailable time) for all providers or resources in the subgroup or department at
once.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/OpTime Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Investigate Log-Based Implants in SlicerDicer
Investigate how you and your organization use log-based implants with a new data model in SlicerDicer,
reporting on, for example, the total number of active implants in your patient population or the number of
implants from a particular manufacturer that you've implanted.
Additional Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/OpTime Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

Specify Multiple Providers When Requesting Cases
Need to specify an assisting provider or an observing resident when requesting a case? You can now enter
multiple providers per panel and specify a role and service for each without leaving your case request workflow.
Additional Changes
New Feature

text:
Share Imaging Orders in Secure Chat
To quickly communicate with colleagues about a patient's imaging order, send the order as an attachment in a
Secure Chat message.
Tip Sheet: Share Imaging Orders in Secure ChatKey Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf

text:
Request Access to Locked Imaging Orders
If you’re unable to open an order because another user has it locked, click Request Access to send a Secure Chat
message to the user with the lock. They can go right from the message to the activity to close the order
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#3
text:
Drag and Drop to Caption Images
Caption images with fewer clicks by dragging them to the quick caption locations on the avatar. When you drag
an image across the avatar, anatomical regions available for captioning are highlighted. Release the mouse when
the appropriate region is highlighted and the anatomical region is automatically added as a caption in the image
ribbon.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#4
text:
More Altered Anatomy Diagrams Available
When a patient has surgically altered anatomy, you can swap out the standard anatomical diagram for one that
accurately reflects the patient's anatomy for EGD, EUS, and ERCP procedures. Selecting the surgery a patient has
undergone from the dropdown menu (A) modifies the diagram to reflect the patient's altered anatomy (B).
Key Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#5
text:
New Antegrade Enteroscopy Diagrams
Standard and modified anatomical diagrams are now available that show the entire small intestine tract
observed during enteroscopies so you can document findings more completely. Selecting the surgery a patient
has undergone from the dropdown menu (A) modifies the diagram to reflect the patient's altered anatomy (B).
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#6
text:
Review Suggested Charges for Ileoscopies and
Pouchoscopies
Quickly review professional charges that the system identifies based on your documented findings in the Wrap-
Up tab in Study Review.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#7
text:
Place Follow-up Orders from the Postprocedure
Navigator
Review endoscopy recommendations and place follow-up orders due within the next year right from the
Postprocedure navigator.
Key Changes
Time Saver

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#8
text:
Impressions Now Appear on the AVS
Impressions you document on an endoscopy study now appear in the AVS for patients to review alongside
recommendations and next steps. If you update the impression later, it is automatically updated across the
system and where patients can see it.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#9
text:
Focus on Tasks Due Soon in the Narrator
Tasks that aren't due in the next hour are
tucked away in a Due Later group (A) in the
Tasks section of the Narrator so you can
focus on what your patient needs next.
Expand the group (B) if you need to
preview upcoming tasks.
As time passes, tasks move automatically
from the Due Later group to the
appropriate category group, like
Documentation or Labs. If you want tasks
to move out of the Due Later group sooner
or later than 60 minutes before their due
time, click the wrench icon in the Narrator
toolbar to adjust that threshold.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#10
text:
Efficient Dual Signoff for Stopped Infusions
When you document the end time of an
infusion using the Infusion Stop button in
the narrator, the Dual Signoff window now
opens if it’s required—no need to use the
full MAR Administration form just to get
your colleague’s signoff.
Click the Stop Infusion button next to a
running infusion in the Active Meds section
of the narrator (1), document the details,
and click Accept (2). If dual signoff is
required, a window appears so your
colleague can enter their credentials (3).
Additional Changes
New Workflow

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Lumens Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#11
text:
Delete Incorrect Flowsheet Documentation Faster
If you notice incorrect flowsheet data filed to the Event Log in a narrator, quickly delete it by clicking the X to the
right instead of opening the event and clearing the data row by row.
Additional Changes
Time Saver

text:
Dig Into Coding Information
Get more details about charges in the new Coding Information
report in the coding sidebar, which provides a convenient
summary of admission details, medications, immunization history,
and more.
If you want to change the order of the information in the Coding
Information report and other additional reports:
1. Click the in the upper right corner of the report and select
Modify Report Layout.
2. Drag and drop the sections to change their order.
3. When you are finished, click Accept.

When you need to change the coverage on a billed hospital account, in the Coverages section of the Account
Summary, a warning banner (1) lets you know the filing order might need to be updated. Review the guarantor
filing order (2) and click the Edit Visit Account Filing Order (3) button to make the necessary changes.

text:
Better DRG Visualization in SlicerDicer
New filters allow you to target and group accounts, transactions, and denials by DRG code set, name, and
version.
Use the Billing DRG Code Set and Billing DRG Code Set and Version filters in the Hospital Accounts (HB & PB)
data model.
Use the Billing DRG Code Set, Billing DRG Code Set and Name, and Billing DRG Code Set and Version filters in
the Transactions (HB & PB), Transactions (HB), and Medication Billing Transactions data models.
Use the Denied DRG Code Set and Denied DRG Code Set and Version filters in the Denials - Invoice (HB), Denials
- Line Level (HB), and Buckets with Open Denials (HB) data models
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024.pdf

meta.file: Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024.pdf

text:
Drill Into Payer Data with New Scorecards
Make informed decisions for improving outcomes and addressing challenges in collections by comparing
insurance payers based on key performance metrics and viewing metric data over time for individual payers in
new payer scorecard dashboards. The top-level dashboard, 41003-EB Payer Scorecard Comparison, shows you a
list of payers and their key performance metrics. Click on a payer in the scorecard to dive into a payer-level
scorecard or lick the name of a metric to further drill down from the payer-level dashboards.
Key Changes
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024.pdf

Jump from Transactions to Line-Level Denials
Jump from the Transactions data models to the Denials - Line Level data model in SlicerDicer to dig deeper into
the root cause for certain denial types. Click the Associated Denials link or the Caused Denials link to find line-
level HB denials associated with or caused by transactions in the Transactions data models.
Additional Changes
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024.pdf
title: Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024

meta.file: Revenue Cycle (Billing) Upgrade Training Resources August 2024.pdf

text:
Slice Transaction Data with New Filters
Keep SlicerDicer reports in balance with the Executive Summary using new filters Account Class (Transaction
Based) and Account Base Class (Transaction Based that filter transactions based on account data from the instant
the transaction was posted. These filters are available in the following data models:
• Transactions (HB & PB)
• Transactions (HB)
• Medication Billing Transactions
Additional Changes
New Feature

You have more options for exploring your open AR with SlicerDicer. The PB Insurance Aged Over 90 Days and
No Recent Activity component on the PB Insurance dashboard helps you target payers that might be slow to
pay so you can follow up on delays. From the component, you can jump to SlicerDicer to dig deeper into root
causes, including by using the new Go to Follow-up Workqueue and Go to Invoice actions for individual
transactions.

denials that were resubmitted to the payer for reconsideration versus denials that were formally appealed:
• Denials - Invoice (HB)
• Denials - Line Level (HB)
• Denials (PB)
• Buckets with Open Denials (HB)
• Charges with Open Denials (PB)

text:
Change the Color of Your Hyperspace Display
If you are colorblind or sensitive to certain shades or contrasts, you can now adjust the brightness, contrast,
saturation, and red, green, and blue values that you see in Hyperspace.
To adjust the settings open the Accessibility activity (search: Accessibility), select the checkbox to enable Color
Filters, and then drag the sliders to modify the way that Hyperspace appears. If you want to return to default
values, click Restore Defaults.
If you change your colors substantially, be sure to double check your key workflows to ensure the system
appears as expected.
New Feature

text:
Get the Bigger Picture from the Rx Sidebar
Several improvements to the Rx Sidebar in the Verify Orders activity make it easier for you to see the medication
information you care about and hide what you don't, without the need to go to the Medications activity while
you verify orders.
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#3
text:
Get the Bigger Picture from the Rx Sidebar (cont.)
Pharmacists can now tailor their Rx Sidebar to
display the types of medications they care about
and the order in which they appear by clicking the
Choose Orders to Show button.
• This includes options to show outpatient
prescriptions as well as patient-reported
medications, which could be useful when evaluating
new admission orders for a patient and comparing
them to what the patient had previously been
taking.
• By default, only inpatient and clinic-administered
medications appear unless an outpatient
prescription is being verified, in which outpatient
medications would appear as well.
New Look

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#4
text:
Document Waste from the Bulk Charge Activity
When you create charges in the Bulk Charge activity, you're now required to document either the Dispense
Amount and Unit, or the Waste Amount and Unit. When you document waste, information for the dispense
amount, unit, and number of dispenses is populated automatically, so you don't need to do the math to find the
difference between the package size and the waste. JZ or JW modifiers are also added automatically based on
the waste you document.
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#5
text:
Leave Comments During Dispense Check
Pharmacists can now write a comment when approving a dispense, giving nurses and pharmacy technicians
additional context when necessary by leaving a note in Dispense Check. For example, mention that the barcode
is unreadable, so that technicians in Dispense Prep know to print a new label or manually enter the information.
Quick Win

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#6
text:
Slice Medication Warnings by Generic Medication
When you use the Medication Warnings data model to investigate trends, you can now filter your results by the
simple generic medication and the warning description to better visualize when and how often warnings appear.
New Feature

sourceId: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf
title: Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024
id: file:RefuelUpgrade/Upgrade vAugust2024/Pharmacy Upgrade Training Slides - August 2024.pdf#7
text:
Rich Text Updates
In Verify Orders, pharmacists may see rich text to organize and
format prep instructions that you want technicians to know during
dispense prep. Hint: Use bolding, numbered steps, and more to
make your instructions easier to read.
For pharmacy technicians, this means that preparation instructions
may look different as a result.

Format
To ensure consistency in electronic signatures across labs, signature times now use the ordering lab's time zone,
include the time zone abbreviation, and appear in 24-hour format.

Associate Multiple Genes with a Single Variant
To support genomic variants associated with more than one gene, multiple genes for a structural or copy
number variant can be entered through an interface or using Manual Variant Entry.

Quick Win
